          Map of context names to name/class pairs. This data is initialized lazily. Example: { "" : { "jdbc" : NCP("jdbc", "java.lang.Context") }, "jdbc" : { "db2" : NCP("db2", "java.lang.Context") }, "jdbc/db2": { "ds" : NCP("ds", type) }, }

        • contexts
